seo.title: Suva homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Suva.

page.heading: SUVA - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger or medical emergency: 911. Domestic violence helpline: 1560. Child helpline: 1325.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: For a safe place to stay, contact the Salvation Army or a domestic-violence support service before travelling. Suva has separate accommodation programmes for young women and young men; admission depends on the programme's criteria and available places.
page.footer: Main sources: Fiji Ministry of Women, Children and Social Protection, Legal Aid Commission, Ministry of Health, Salvation Army, Medical Services Pacific, Fiji Women's Crisis Centre and Fiji Red Cross.

entries.title: Salvation Army Eastern Fiji Community Ministries
entries.description: Welfare assistance and referrals for people in hardship. The Suva programme can explain current food, clothing and accommodation options.
entries.how_to_access: Call before travelling and explain what help is needed.

entries.title: Fiji Adult Counselling Hotline
entries.description: Confidential crisis counselling and referral for adults, including people affected by gender-based violence.

entries.title: Red Shield House
entries.description: Salvation Army supportive accommodation for young women in Suva. Admission requirements and vacancies are not published.
entries.how_to_access: Call before travelling. Ask about age criteria, referral requirements and vacancies.

entries.title: Raiwai Hostel
entries.description: Salvation Army supportive accommodation for young men. It is a programme rather than a guaranteed walk-in night shelter.
entries.how_to_access: Call before travelling. Admission depends on assessment and space.

entries.title: Salvation Army Family Care Centre
entries.description: Safe accommodation for women escaping domestic violence, homelessness or human trafficking. The centre location is kept limited for safety; Community Ministries can arrange contact.
entries.how_to_access: Contact Community Ministries or the domestic violence helpline 1560. Do not travel to a confidential safe house without referral.

entries.title: Salvation Army welfare assistance
entries.description: Emergency welfare support may include food and clothing, depending on assessment and supplies.
entries.how_to_access: Call before visiting to confirm what assistance is available and what information to bring.

entries.title: Fiji Red Cross Society
entries.description: Humanitarian assistance, health and disaster support. Help is normally based on assessed need and current programmes, not a daily walk-in food or shelter guarantee.
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain the situation. In an immediate emergency use 911.

entries.title: Salvation Army clothing assistance
entries.description: Donated clothing and welfare assistance may be available through the Raiwai or Suva Community Ministries offices.
entries.how_to_access: Ask what is available before travelling.

entries.title: Colonial War Memorial Hospital
entries.description: Suva's main public referral hospital. Use the emergency department for urgent medical care and 911 for a medical emergency.
entries.how_to_access: Go to the emergency department for urgent care. Ask about charges and identification requirements for non-emergency services.

entries.title: Medical Services Pacific clinic
entries.description: Sexual and reproductive health, women and adolescent health, post-rape care, counselling, child protection support and legal referrals.
entries.how_to_access: Call the Suva clinic. For sexual or gender-based violence, use the published counselling or legal-aid contacts.

entries.title: Ministry of Women, Children and Social Protection - Social Welfare
entries.description: Government programmes include temporary family assistance, disability allowance, care and protection support and transport assistance. Eligibility rules apply.
entries.address: Level 2, Abacus Building, 72 Suva Street, Suva
entries.how_to_access: Use the eligibility portal or visit the nearest Social Welfare Office. Bring available identification and household information.

entries.title: Fiji employment services
entries.description: Government employment and labour services can provide information about job registration, worker rights and available programmes.
entries.how_to_access: Check the current contact information and ask how to register as a job seeker.

entries.title: Legal Aid Commission - Suva
entries.description: Free legal advice and representation for people who cannot afford a private lawyer, subject to the Commission's rules. Separate Suva units handle criminal, family and civil matters.
entries.how_to_access: Call shortcode 1506 or the relevant Suva unit before visiting.

entries.title: Fiji National Domestic Violence Helpline
entries.description: Free confidential support and information for people experiencing domestic violence. The referral network can connect callers with counselling, police, health, legal aid and safe accommodation.
entries.how_to_access: Call 1560. Use 911 if there is immediate danger.

entries.title: Medical Services Pacific gender-based violence support
entries.description: Counselling, post-rape care, child protection, human-rights support and legal assistance for survivors of violence.
entries.how_to_access: Call the counselling hotline or the Suva clinic. Services are confidential.
